from collections import defaultdict

def path_sum_iii(root, target):
    count = 0
    sums = defaultdict(int)
    sums[0] = 1
    def dfs(node, cur):
        nonlocal count
        if not node:
            return
        cur += node.val
        count += sums[cur - target]
        sums[cur] += 1
        dfs(node.left, cur)
        dfs(node.right, cur)
        sums[cur] -= 1
    dfs(root, 0)
    return count
```
